title: Demo walkthrough
description: The longer product tour, 60 to 180 seconds, for a viewer who chose to watch: one real workflow done end to end instead of a feature tour, chapter shares and chapter cards, narration at 2.2 to 2.5 words a second that may orient ahead of a step, UI magnified 2 to 2.5 times, cursor and click timing, focus pushes, cutting dead waits, beat sheets for 60, 90, 120 and 180 seconds, the quiet sound plan, and when to split into a series. Load it for onboarding videos, sales or investor demos, and product tours too long for a launch film.
summary: The 60–180 s product tour: one workflow end to end, chaptered, magnified until it reads, narrated for a viewer who opted in.

requires.why: The real recording or screenshots the tour is built on.
Narration that orients the viewer ahead of each step.
A click per press, typing texture and a success chime.
An optional minimal bed under the narration.
Checking each chapter's share of the runtime against the plan.
Legibility of each acted-on label is a frame check.
Contact sheets to find dead waits, and the loudness check.

route.deliverable: A 1–3 minute narrated walkthrough of one product workflow, start to finish, in chapters
askFirst: Which workflow should it walk through, start to finish?
Is there a screen recording, or should it be rebuilt from screenshots?
Who watches it: a new user, a buyer, or an investor?

models.note: Measured, explanatory. This viewer already opted in.

triggers: make an onboarding video for our product
how-to video for setting up our app
step by step tutorial of our dashboard
